about_the_game:
Play as Opie, the apprentice to the grand maestro of the universe. Something terrible has happened to the music that keeps existence humming and orderly, and Silence is threatening to turn all of everything into a blobby, quiet mess.

And naturally, Opie is blamed for the entire thing. 

Explore the depths of the Wilds to gather Sound Sprites. Protect them (and yourself) from hungry, ever-expanding Silence. Reconnect the Sound Sprites to the songs of the universe (in whatever way suits you) to bring color, shape and groove back to existence.

Key features

  • Explore the Wilds in any direction you choose.

  • Rebuild the soundtrack to the game piece by piece- customizing it to your liking along the way.

  • Entirely hand-crafted visuals and animations by artist Patrick Edell and animator Amanda Schrembeck.

  • Sound Sprites are charming and adorable and they want to love you- please let them love you.

  • Everything sounds great by default- no musical abilities required!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel or AMD Dual Core at 2 GHz or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Graphics 4400 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 600 MB available space

short_description: An adventure game, but you play musical instruments instead of swinging swords. Gather adorable Sound Sprites, cut through the looming Silence, and rebuild the soundtrack of this hand-illustrated world in whatever way you see fit. No musical ability required!
